claim: Across the 15 clones no editor or library writes its own whole-document editor model into a DOCX it exports. The two DOCX editors that embed anything (SuperDoc, eigenpal) embed caller-owned per-record payloads in Word-native customXml parts anchored by Word-visible content controls; pandoc writes metadata strings to docProps/custom.xml and never reads them back; BlockNote and windoc export only. SuperDoc engine is closed, so its writer is inferred from its API contract. Scores impact 3 novelty 2 applicability 3 proofability 2 risk 1.

claim: Authority rule: the Word-visible control decides whether a payload exists. A payload no w:sdt binds (w:dataBinding storeItemID + one fixed xpath shape) is swept on open, so a control deleted in Word deletes its payload; a bound control is read-only in Word and painted from the store, so text and payload cannot drift; an unbound node whose text a Word user edits hands the changed text to the host fromDocx. Correspondence is by ID binding, not by digest. Scores impact 3 novelty 2 applicability 2 proofability 3 risk 1.

claim: ECMA-376 Part 1 (quoted on the SC34 WG4 list): consumers shall not fail on unknown relationships; producers that are also consumers can, but are not required to, roundtrip unknown relationships and their target parts; parts no relationship targets are unknown parts that can be discarded on production. Plate attaches editor/authored.json from the root _rels/.rels with relationship type https://platejs.org/relationships/authored, which ECMA classes as unknown, so no conforming producer owes it survival. Scores impact 3 novelty 2 applicability 3 proofability 1 risk 1.

In-body markup is not a carrier for editor state; data parts are. Scores impact 2 novelty 1 applicability 2 proofability 2 risk 0.

opendoc preserves unconsumed parts verbatim but drops digital signatures on a semantic save because any edit invalidates a byte-bound artifact. Plate envelope records a sha256 per package part, so it is byte-bound the same way: any Word or LibreOffice resave that rewrites document.xml makes it unusable whether or not the part survives. Inference for Plate; opendoc behavior is source-read. Scores impact 2 novelty 2 applicability 3 proofability 2 risk 1.

claim: Office reserves customXml root namespaces for its own document metadata (SharePoint content type and properties, cover page properties, long properties), and Word-produced packages carry a bibliography Sources store in customXml/item1.xml and an add-in webextension part with we:properties. Microsoft itself keeps application state in customXml or add-in parts, never in a private JSON part. Scores impact 1 novelty 1 applicability 2 proofability 1 risk 0.

eigenpal derives ds:itemID from a hash of the main part, core.xml and settings.xml bytes plus namespace, and re-salts on collision, because (per its comments) Word dedupes its data store on itemID and binds a pasted control to the host document store. The Word dedupe claim is the repository statement, not observed here. Only matters if state moves into customXml. Scores impact 1 novelty 3 applicability 1 proofability 2 risk 1.
